summary: Change 2283 makes the source generator and MsgPack00x analyzer tolerate closed generic value types (including record structs) from referenced assemblies used as members of [MessagePackObject] types: member-location access is null-safe (FirstOrDefault()?) and analyzer diagnostics are filtered through ReportIfLocatedInCompilation so metadata-declared members are not reported against locations outside the compilation. Three new tests pass and the build passes, but the full suite has a new failure (MsgPack00xAnalyzerTests.NullStringKey, expected 1 diagnostic, actual 0) because the BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic for properties was commented out rather than made null-safe, so REQ-2283-N1 is not met and REQ-2283-N2 cannot be evidenced (tests.fail_without_fix was not run).

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: The three new metadata-reference tests pass on head and the build passes; head TypeCollector.cs guards member-location access with FirstOrDefault()? (line 1077) so metadata-declared closed generic members no longer crash the generator, and the resolver is asserted to be generated.

The new tests run the analyzer over usage source referencing a metadata-only defining assembly and fail on any diagnostic, so an AD0001 analyzer throw would fail them; all three pass and the build passes.

All analyzer diagnostics are routed through ReportIfLocatedInCompilation (head line 239), which reports only when the diagnostic location is in a syntax tree contained in the compilation (head line 1446), and the metadata unkeyed-member test passes with no diagnostics.

findings.title: Existing analyzer diagnostic disabled: MsgPack00xAnalyzerTests.NullStringKey now fails
findings.claim: The BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic invocation for properties was commented out (head TypeCollector.cs line 985) while it was active on base (base line 985), so MsgPack00xAnalyzerTests.NullStringKey expects 1 diagnostic but gets 0; this failure is not present on base. The null-safe helper GetPropertyIdentifierLocation is already referenced in the commented code, so the crash-prone indexing should have been replaced with it instead of disabling the diagnostic, which also suppresses it for in-source types.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the property diagnostic using GetPropertyIdentifierLocation(item) (which returns null for metadata-declared properties and is dropped by ReportIfLocatedInCompilation) so in-source diagnostics are preserved while metadata members are skipped; then re-run the full suite.

findings.title: Inconsistent BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull handling between properties and fields
findings.claim: The property form of BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull is disabled (commented out at head line 985) while the field form remains active (head line 1128) using the null-safe FirstOrDefault()? pattern, and the commented property code is dead code.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the property invocation with GetPropertyIdentifierLocation(item) or remove the commented block, keeping property and field handling consistent.
